name: flow-patterns-example
description: AGBoss example: the zero-cost harness of the public surface — flow patterns (a review loop, a code router, parallel launches, a quorum, child workflows, recursion, two approvals at once, undo), the extension points on an offline transport model provider, two applications over A2A checked by check --federation, an offline eval suite, a VCR cassette recorded offline; scripted tests, real runs with OPENROUTER_API_KEY

scripts.check: agboss check --strict --cassettes --application src/desk.application.ts --federation snapshots/ && agboss describe --json --application src/desk.application.ts > .agboss/desk-application.json && agboss check --strict --federation .agboss/desk-application.json && agboss check --models --env test && eslint . && npm run -s eval:check && npm run -s records:check
scripts.eval: PII_PSEUDONYM_KEY=offline-only agboss eval run --application src/desk.application.ts --env offline --suite desk-eval-suite --runs 2 --report eval/runs/desk-eval-suite.json
scripts.eval:check: PII_PSEUDONYM_KEY=offline-only agboss eval run --application src/desk.application.ts --env offline --suite desk-eval-suite --runs 2 --report .agboss/eval/desk-eval-suite.json --baseline eval/runs/desk-eval-suite.json --fail-on-regression && agboss eval show eval/runs/desk-eval-suite.json --html .agboss/eval/desk-eval-suite.html && agboss eval calibrate --report eval/runs/desk-eval-suite.json
